parameters.query:
SELECT id, name, slug, icon, description, sort_order
FROM amenities
WHERE is_active = 1
ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC;

SELECT a.id, a.name, a.slug, a.icon, a.description, a.sort_order, ca.note
FROM centers__amenities ca
INNER JOIN amenities a ON a.id = ca.amenity_id
WHERE ca.center_id = $1
  AND a.is_active = 1
ORDER BY a.sort_order ASC, a.id ASC;

VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'pending');

parameters.query:
SELECT r.id, r.center_id, c.name AS center_name, r.requested_by, r.name, r.description, r.status, r.admin_note, r.amenity_id, r.reviewed_by, r.reviewed_at, r.created_at
FROM amenities__requests r
LEFT JOIN centers c ON c.id = r.center_id
WHERE ($1 = '' OR r.status = $1)
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC;
DELETE FROM centers__amenities WHERE center_id = $1;

parameters.query:
SELECT id, name, slug, sort_order, is_active
FROM centers__care_items
WHERE is_active = 1
ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC;

SELECT ci.id, ci.name, ci.slug, ci.sort_order,
       COALESCE(v.has_it, 0) AS has_it, v.note
FROM centers__care_items ci
LEFT JOIN centers__care_item_values v
  ON v.care_item_id = ci.id AND v.center_id = $1
WHERE ci.is_active = 1
ORDER BY ci.sort_order ASC, ci.id ASC;
DELETE FROM centers__care_item_values WHERE center_id = $1;
